title: Conversion of hazardous fluorine-containing sludge into monodisperse, highly crystalline, and acid-grade CaF2 nanomaterials via digestive ripening under acid-enhanced hydrothermal treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3191-3202
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00113G, Paper
Guangxin Liao, Li Li, Zeyu Kang, Xibing Zhou, Jie Li, Zhulin Xue, Huiqin Gao, Zhang Lin, Weizhen Liu
Fluorine-containing sludge (FCS) was converted into monodisperse, highly crystalline, and high-purity CaF2 nanomaterials via a digestive ripening process under hydrofluoric acid-enhanced hydrothermal treatment.
